title: Minimal EFC Effective Field Theory Ansatz: Scalar-Tensor and Vector-Tensor Formulations with Gravitational Slip from Entropy Gradients
abstract: Proposes a minimal effective field theory completion for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) in two formulations: a Horndeski-like scalar–tensor EFT and a vector–tensor EFT with a dynamical energy-flow 4-vector. Both are driven by a sigmoid entropy field S(a) that ensures GR recovery at high redshift and targets a mid‑z signature with weakened growth (mu < 1), gravitational slip (eta > 1), and enhanced lensing (Sigma > 1). The note defines the observables, derives the slip mechanism from entropy-gradient anisotropic stress, and specifies stability/consistency conditions, with numerical evaluation deferred to hi_class/EFTCosmoMC.
keywords: effective field theory of dark energy
